nodes.summary: Markdown document "SCRUM-110 G3 Evidence" (document, 3 lines): GitHub PR metadata is authoritative for the exact current head SHA. Repository records in this folder preserve scope, validation mode and non-authorized boundaries; they do not grant merge authority.

nodes.name: current head authority

nodes.summary: Markdown document "SCRUM-110 G3 Head Binding" (document, 5 lines): The exact Draft PR head SHA is captured through GitHub authoritative PR readback after PR creation. This note avoids a self-referential commit hash inside the commit that creates it.

nodes.name: no more pre pr state
